channel.title: Olive Oil Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Olive Oil Times (oliveoiltimes.com)

item.title: Women Farmers at the Forefront of Olive Oil’s Future, UN Says
item.description: As the United Nations prepares for the International Year of the Woman Farmer in 2026, women olive oil producers from Greece, Portugal, Tunisia and Lebanon share how resilience, sustainability and stewardship guide their work.

item.title: Olive Oil Sector Weighs Opportunities and Risks as EU-Mercosur Deal Nears Approval
item.description: As the EU-Mercosur free trade agreement moves closer to approval, olive oil producers in Europe and South America are weighing new export opportunities against concerns over competition and market balance.

item.title: Study Finds Extra Virgin Olive Oil Improves Vascular Function in Hyperlipidemia Patients
item.description: A randomized controlled trial in Greece found that extra virgin olive oil consumption improved vascular function and key cardiovascular markers in patients with hyperlipidemia.

item.title: EU Lawmakers Delay Mercosur Trade Deal After Narrow Vote
item.description: Less than a week after the EU–Mercosur trade deal was signed, the European Parliament voted to delay its approval pending a legal review.

item.title: Olive Oil Times Sommelier Certificate Program Returns to London in March
item.description: The Olive Oil Times Education Lab will host its five-day Sommelier Certificate Program in London from March 9 to 13, offering immersive instruction in olive oil sensory analysis, production, health, culinary applications and quality assessment.

item.title: Congressional Bill Would Require Federal Definition for Olive Oil Labels
item.description: A bipartisan bill in Congress would require the FDA to establish a national standard of identity for olive oil, a move supporters say would strengthen enforcement and protect consumers.

item.title: How Olive Oil Importers Navigate the Turbulent but Lucrative U.S. Market
item.description: U.S. olive oil consumption is forecast to reach a record high in 2025/26, as demand continues to grow despite inflation, tariffs and weakening consumer confidence.

item.title: How Extra Virgin Olive Oil Elevates Traditional Neapolitan Pizza
item.description: One of the world's most celebrated pizza makers, Salvatore Salvo of Pizzeria Salvo in Naples shares his insights on pairing pizza and extra virgin olive oil.

item.title: New Study Ranks Areas in Greece Most Suitable for Olive Cultivation
item.description: Researchers say climate and terrain data could help farmers, insurers and policymakers plan the future of olive cultivation in Greece.

item.title: From Ancient Olive Trees to Michelin Recognition, Croatian Producers Redefine Agritourism
item.description: Croatian producers Nives and Goran Morović restored a 400-year-old olive grove on Dugi Otok, producing award-winning extra virgin olive oils and creating an estate recently recognized with three Michelin Keys.
